name: API Xref Hunter
description: Find every function that calls any API from a configurable set of names.
longdescription: Define a set of API names (glob, regex, substring or exact match) and get every function in the binary that calls any of them, grouped by caller. Ships with editable presets for registry, network, process injection, crypto, filesystem, dynamic resolution and anti-analysis APIs. Supports transitive caller discovery, a clickable markdown report, and optional tagging so hits appear in the Tags sidebar.
